what: people topics (unemployment, ageing, urban share): the opening picture is real flat-colour CC0 people drawings painted by runtime/illus_hero/people in the page palette; the strip that stands in for it draws the crowd and ages pieces of pieces-energy.cjs

knobs.name: baseline
knobs.what: the shared ground line (px from the top; 0.6 to 0.9 of the height)

knobs.name: margin
knobs.what: room around a piece inside its cell (px)

knobs.name: roughness
knobs.what: how rough the pen is (0.6 to 0.8, the hand-drawn range set for the strip)

knobs.name: seed
knobs.what: the pen's seed: the same seed draws the same strip (rough.js takes 0 as no seed, a new strip each time)

knobs.name: min_feature
knobs.what: a closed shape or line smaller than this (px, as drawn) is left out and reported

knobs.name: marker
knobs.what: 1 draws each cell's circled number (strokes, no text), 0 none; off until a legend on the page refers to the numbers through the ledger

hero.what: the opening picture of a page of these tables: one figure per member (node.json scenes.people.renderer = scene: the scene renderer runtime/illus_hero/scene for a tally, runtime/illus_hero/people, its renderer_else, for the other layouts), composed from the finding's rows; it needs no hero parts, so `tables` gives each table an empty tag list; `hero` is not read on that path; `ground` the paper, `accent` the page's accent by its colour name (run_hero resolves var(--accent) from the page palette)
